summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Vanguard Russell 3000 ETF (VTHR) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell 3000 indexThe fund tracks a market-cap-weighted index that measures the investable US equity space, covering the entire market-cap spectrum including micro-caps. VTHR was launched on Sep 20, 2010 and is issued by Vanguard.

holdings.infoBox: VTHR is an equity ETF with a total of 2989 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 6.95%, Apple at 6.19%, Microsoft at 5.09%, Alphabet at 4.83%, and Amazon.com at 3.40%.
